data.title: Crimson Star
data.description:
Lucian finds himself in a new world with no one to rely on but his military skills, a group of outcasts and powers gain from his new world. He will have to navigate a world he doesn’t understand, with enemies in every corner, and dreams his not sure are just dreams. In Order to protect those he loves and survive what’s coming he will need all the help he can get. With the slightest chance he might make his way back to home and world his not sure he wants to return to.

With a chance to start over in a new world is it worth it to go back to a world and a past that might be best left forgotten and buried?

data.title: Shinrabansho: Myriad Souls
data.description:
When Susumu answers a call from his dead first love, it sets off a chain of events that should have killed him... instead, it marks him. A Noh-Face yokai strips away pieces of his identity and leaves him half-transformed, cursed with a “Cinderella Deadline”... He has only twenty-four hours to hunt down the creature that stole his face before he loses everything... his humanity, his identity, and his mind. 

His only hope is the SSDS: Shinohara Spiritual Detective Services. He collides with a violent, pint-sized yuri-obsessed prodigy, a sweet-but-lethal vampire, a fox-eared angel with questionable priorities, and a shapeshifting tanuki menace who can turn into anything from a girl to a missile. 

Together, they drag Susumu into Tokyo’s yokai underworld, where Noh-Face murders spread terror across the city and the truth behind the death that shattered his life waits like a blade in the dark. 

Will he become the monster he’s chasing?

If you’re looking for urban fantasy, yokai, horror, found-family, chaos, harem, sentai, absurdity, slapstick, comedy, tragedy, romance, identity, horror, fanservice, gender bending and unhinged supernatural shenanigans — this story is for you.

True Genres:  Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Gender Bender, Girls Love, Harem, Horror, Martial Arts, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Slice of Life (For those chapters), Supernatural, Tragedy (But I could only choose 9)

This book is the fully refined version of my third novel, and the entire first volume is already complete. I will be publishing it as a full, polished work. I know exactly what constitutes a successful and good story.. no more unrealistic expectations. Right now I'm just telling the story I want to, however it works out.

It will not be perfect... even after a full rewrite.

But the entire first book is complete, and I will be publishing the whole thing.

Expectations:
You’ll smile.
You’ll cry.
The MC will be gender bent by the end of the first book.
The MC will hurt—a lot. Blood. Broken bones.
The MC will change and grow.
There will be action and real fights.
The main cast will be entirely female.
There will be plenty of yuri.
There will be an absurd amount of kissing and cuddling.
There will be no smut.
There will be plenty of ecchi fanservice.

And this story won’t end with No Face, No Life. It's only the beginning. The series will continue as an ongoing serialized saga.

No set schedule for releases. A very popular author that I know doesn't publish regularly and her work is still wildly popular.

data.title: One/two (GL)
data.description:
One/Two

Mona is the kind of girl who always has a sarcastic comeback, a fearless attitude, and zero patience for unnecessary drama. But when she finds herself caught between friendship and love, she begins to question something she never thought about before...

"Which is more important—friendship or love?'

As hilarious misunderstandings, siblings fighting, unforgettable school memories, heartfelt family moments, and unexpected relationships shape their lives, Mona and her friends learn that growing up isn't about having all the answers. It's about discovering what—and who—truly matters.

A heartwarming high school story filled with comedy, romance, friendship & family bonding, laughter & emotions that stay with you long after the last page.

Time is money my friend. Choose with your own choice.

data.title: Written for You
data.description:
"I hope that, three years from now, I'll have at least one person I can truly call a friend."
For as long as she could remember, Miyuki Yukimura had always lived on the outside of everyone else's world.
Conversations never lasted. Friendships never began. Even after entering college, she believed nothing would change—until a single performance by the university's theater club quietly captured her heart.
Unable to act yet unable to look away, Miyuki decides to join the club, where she meets Fuyumi Yuzuhara, a calm and distant girl whose presence somehow feels strangely comforting. As rehearsals become routines and ordinary days slowly turn into unforgettable memories, the distance between them begins to fade.
Alongside five new friends, Miyuki discovers that college isn't only about chasing dreams or preparing for the future. Sometimes, it's about finding the people who make even the most ordinary moments worth remembering.
Some encounters happen by chance.
Some stories are written by fate.
And some people quietly change your life before you even realize it.

data.title: The Stars That Cannot Speak
data.description:
Rules for surviving the Celestial Court:
1. Keep your head low.
2. Make your posture clumsy.
3. Let your answers seem dull.
4. Never, under any circumstance, attract the attention of the Imperial Astrologer.
⸻
Chao Xing loved the harsh simplicity of her mountain valley. She knew every winding trail, every medicinal herb, and every stiff movement of the grandparents she worked four jobs to protect. She was ready to stay there forever.

Instead, she was sent to Changyuan—a monster of stone, iron, and thousands of strangers.

Disguised as a common servant in the luxurious yet toxic Western Concubine Pavilions, Chao Xing has to hide her natural strength under the gray robes of a quiet maid. Together with a disciplined warrior girl and a gentle, book-loving prince, she forms a secret alliance to navigate a world where a single mistake means death.

But the palace is a gilded cage built on centuries of bloodshed and forgotten history. When an ancient, forbidden magic stirs within her veins, Chao Xing accidentally disrupts the perfect, calculated board of Master Shen Xuan—the dangerous, white-haired astrologer who controls the fate of millions behind his silk blindfold.

He doesn't know her secret yet. He thinks she is just a clumsy rat. But as their silent, psychological battle begins, the morning star is finally waking up in the dark.
⸻
Genre: Epic Fantasy / Slow Burn / Enemies to Lovers / Hidden Power

An independent fantasy novel by Jerixa.

Note: This story contains AI-assisted/AI-generated text elements.

data.title: HANS: The Beginning of the Story
data.description: At the age of sixteen, Hans was nothing more than an ordinary high school student. One day, he fell asleep during class and found himself in a strange dream. Before him stood an unknown being that repeatedly asked him to shake its hand. Hans refused at first, unable to understand what it wanted. Eventually, curiosity got the better of him. The moment their hands touched, his body was engulfed in golden flames. He woke up with a start, falling from his chair. Convinced it had all been nothing more than a bizarre dream, he returned to his normal life. What Hans didn't realize was that the flames had been real. From that moment on, he was no longer an ordinary boy. He had awakened as a demon.

data.title: Touch of Lightning (Lightning Touch Book 1)
data.description:
A dangerous job. A mining disaster. A declaration of love that may have come too late. 
Her job in a space station requires nerves of steel and a cold heart, but Lennina is paralyzed with fear for the life of her work partner each time there’s an earthquake on the planet’s surface. Her jealous boyfriend accuses her of having an affair with him and turns to violence when she denies it. 
Bruised and broken, she ends the relationship. Then when a quake traps miners underground, she discovers her work partner means more to her than life itself. 
As a new telepathic ability manifests itself, can Lennina use it to save the man she loves? 
TOUCH OF LIGHTNING is an exciting first book in the Lightning Touch Series that will transport sci-fi and paranormal fans to a distant space station, filled with suspense, danger, and romance. If you like reading stories about low-spice relationships with a slow-burn forbidden love and sassy, witty banter, you’ll love this friends-to-lovers sci-fi adventure with a HEA. 
© 2019 Susan McKenzie. All rights reserved.

data.title: Surviving The Tutorial With An OP Girlfriend
data.description:
How does a relatively normal guy survive an impossible tutorial when his girlfriend keeps charging headfirst into danger just because she's built different?

Nobody survives the Impossible Tutorial.

That isn't an opinion.

It's a fact.

For years, Players chosen by the Game from every nation on Earth have entered the Tutorial seeking power, glory, and fame. Some chose Easy. Some chose Hard. A few ambitious idiots chose Nightmare, and somehow survived.

But every person who chose Impossible died.

Adam Colt knew this.

His girlfriend Mei Mori knew it too, but she didn't care.

One impulsive click later, she selected Impossible difficulty and vanished into the Tutorial.

Adam had less than a second to make a decision.

Let her go alone.

Or follow her into a challenge nobody had ever survived.

Now trapped inside a fantasy world on the highest difficulty setting imaginable, the two must complete the Tutorial's main questline:

Protect the Human Kingdom, Survive the Demon King's invasion, and somehow defeat the Demon King himself.

The problem?

Impossible difficulty isn't called Impossible for nothing.

Monsters are stronger.

Resources are scarce.

The rules are borderline unfair.

And the Tutorial is hiding far more than it's willing to reveal.

Fortunately, Mei is absurdly overpowered.

Unfortunately, Adam has to survive long enough to benefit from it.

— — —

What to expect:

• An OP gremlin of a girlfriend who treats impossible odds as a suggestion (not an actual gremlin…)
• A capable protagonist who serves as the team's brain cell (he might only have a few left after all of Mei's antics)
• Modern firearms in a fantasy world (powered by magic & gunpowder!)
• RPG mechanics, classes, talents, and progression
• A single romantic pairing (no harem)
• Comedy, action, and plenty of bad decisions

data.title: The Ninety-Ninth Bride
data.description:
Sable died after catching her boyfriend of five years cheating.

When she wakes, it isn’t in a hospital—it’s in another world.

Now living as the daughter of a minor noble family, Sable decides to do something she never managed in her old life: live for herself. No obligations. No sacrifices. No getting stuck in situations that don’t benefit her.

Then a cursed king appears and asks her to marry him.

Azrael has had ninety-eight wives.
None survived. None succeeded.

Sable refuses.

She has no interest in becoming number ninety-nine for a solution that has never worked—especially not for a man who expects her to say yes without question.

Unfortunately, Azrael doesn’t leave.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
What to Expect: Slow-burn fantasy romance, Rational, pragmatic female lead, Morally grey male lead, Character-driven progression, No insta-love

Alternative title(s): Bound to a Cursed King & I Refused the Demon's Proposal: The Curse isn't my problem

Approved Platforms: Webnovel, Royal Road, Wattpad, Inkitt, Tapas & Scribble Hub

data.title: Reader of the Novel’s Extra
data.description:
Waking up, Lee Shin found himself in an unfamiliar world AND an unfamiliar body. A world that he definitely DID not create, and a story he DEFINITELY did not write. But, ironically, one he never finished.

He had become an extra in a novel. But not just ANY novel. 

The Novel's Extra. That novel. The one he stopped reading halfway through. The one that he last read close to ten years ago.

F*ck.

data.title: Trapped in Another World With No Magic
data.description:
Daniel is just a regular blue collar Maintenance Mechanic working for a manufacturing company. As he's winding down at home from a day of messy work repairing a CNC mill, he is surprised by a sudden glow of light beneath him. And, in an instant, his world changes. Literally.

Daniel finds himself now in the world of Zenkon, a world of fantasy beings and monsters, swords and magic, and perilous threats to the safety of the world. As if stepping into a fantasy light novel or video game, he has been apparently summoned by a sacred magic spell that requests a hero from the gods, and in reply, they sent Daniel and a young Japanese man named Rikuto. 

However, Daniel's luck doesn't seem to be good, as it's quickly discovered that, contrary to the nature of living things in the world of Zenkon, Daniel is the only one that possesses no magic or mana, making him immune to many types of magic, both beneficial and detrimental, but not protecting him from direct harm.

As such, Daniel will now have to find his way through this world using his own repair and manufacturing know-how, while Rikuto uses his own modern civics and economics knowledge to try to recover the Kingdom of Mornistae in the midst of a large scale global war.

Why were they summoned, and by what wisdom did the gods choose to send 'Divine Heroes'; one with magic and the other without, to a world of which the foundation is magic?

data.title: Returning Transcendent Opens an Idol Agency
data.description:
The Devilish Genius of Time and Effort. That Cheating Bastard. Idiot Savant. A man known by countless names in the Three Realms, one who collected every treasure, every ancient art, whose Dao of 'Accumulation' made him the richest and most hated person even amongst the Eternal Emperors.

The strongest Transcendent, the one envied by all beneath the heavens. After breaking past the bounds of existence, he-

"I'm heading home."

"W-Wait! Master!"

-Promptly packed his bags and returned to Earth.

A story about a laidback overpowered guy who underestimated how hard it is to be abnormal in a normal world and gets swept up into the flow too quickly... And also ended up opening an idol agency.

Thus begins the tale of John Smith and his daily adventures back on Earth.

Current cover art by: @Crymsie (Twitter/X)

===

Partially on Webnovel and Tapas in just a text version. Soon to be on Royal Road.

data.title: For the Worth of Your Life
data.description:
A Tale of a Hero, Kenji Sovern, forced to become the son of the Demon Lord.

Now seen as a threat from his own kind and the Demons who're supposed to support him, he's left in a simple eternal boring limbo.

Now roaming the world as Anze Leondell, he seeks for a way to become human once more. Will he manage to become human once more? Or will he stay as the Demon Prince for eternity?

data.title: Fleet Simulation N: Baphomet
data.description:
A player of the Civilization Annihilation Game's merit is not seen only through how well they destroy civilizations and slaughter people, but also how they manage the intrigue and politics between players, how they can undermine the other while staying on top. It is a reality show, after all.

Unlike Shamash who ingratiates herself with the Executive Producer, Baphomet, the current top scorer of the Game, chooses to provide the Executive Producer with ideas for side contents in the way he knows best: men slaughtering each other.

And so, while the Executive Producer is on vacation and the Game's next season isn't open yet, Baphomet invites the Audience to watch the Fleet Simulation N.

"Do you want total war!? Do you want it, if necessary, more total and radical than anything that we can yet today even conceive!?"

ALTERNATIVE TITLE: One of JARS's antagonists wants a story of nothing but war, as the Civilization Annihilation Game originally intended. Maintaining the agenda is our top priority.

DISCLAIMER: (This is a crossover fan work of the novels Nihonkoku Shoukan/Summoning Japan, which belongs to Minorou, and The Resurrected Fleet: Isekai World War 1942, which belongs to Yuuma Hiiragi.)

Cross-posted on FF.net and Wattpad

data.title: The Noble System: Rise of House Marci
data.description: After dying because of corporate negligence, Ryan awakens as Ian von der Marci, the disgraced heir of one of the Four Great Noble Houses in a modern empire ruled by nobles, corporations, and political power. Armed with the Noble System and knowledge from his previous life, he must rebuild House Marci, outmaneuver rival houses, dominate future industries, and rise to the top of the empire.

data.title: Where Time Breaks
data.description:
He has died more times than anyone knows.
Each time, the world resets—yet he alone remembers everything.

No one else recalls the broken timelines. No one else carries the weight of what has been lost.

Yuma continues to return, bound to a promise he never chose, saving a world that never remembers his sacrifice.

But when the cycle begins to fracture, the rules that kept everything intact start to collapse.
And for the first time, he may no longer be able to face it alone.

data.title: Small Worlds
data.description:
Small Worlds is a slice-of-life novel about two women living ordinary lives on opposite sides of the world.

Lena has built a quiet life in the Netherlands, balancing a career in the music industry with a love for composing. In Japan, Aiko divides her time between freelance illustration and evenings spent sharing her art through livestreams.

When Lena stumbles across one of Aiko's broadcasts, what begins as simple background noise becomes an unexpected window into another way of living. As one small curiosity leads to another, the distance between their separate worlds begins to shrink.

Told through everyday moments, creative pursuits, and the passing of the seasons, Small Worlds is a gentle story about how ordinary lives can become extraordinary simply by making room for someone else.

data.title: End of the World Safe Zone
data.description:
Shen Tian kicks the bucket, squashed by a truck – yep, totally cliché. But hang on, death's just a pit stop. Meet the "world administrator," a cosmic dealmaker. Shen Tian's back on the land of the living, but with a twist: he's in a zany apocalyptic land now.

World savior vibes incoming! Shen Tian's job? DIY – Build a shelter for humankind, in case zombies RSVP for lunch. Step one: quests! Think scavenger hunts with a twist. Shen Tian's treasure? Blueprints for a fortress that even doomsday would think twice about crashing.

Shen Tian's a modern-day MacGyver, mixing brains and brawn to gather survivors. Call it a post-apocalyptic party, where monsters crash – and Shen Tian's the bouncer. Mission: Secure snacks, save humanity!

Danger's the new normal. Will Shen Tian raise humanity's last safe haven, or will zombies crash his crib-warming party? Get ready for a zombie-zapping, apocalypse-building joyride!

data.title: ZWORD : Echoes Of Ash
data.description:
The Zwords were said to have vanished long ago.
History claims they were defeated.
History lies.
Rayan lives as the descendant of a forgotten people forced to hide their identity beneath the rule of the Zenith Empire. Without Power, without status, and with no reason to believe the legends of his ancestors, his only goal is survival.
But when he witnesses the execution of a man for claiming to be a Zword, Rayan discovers that the Empire still fears a race the world believes is extinct.
Some truths were buried.
Some swords were never broken.
And some echoes refuse to fade.
Zword: Echoes of Ash is a dark progression fantasy filled with ancient swordsmanship, hidden bloodlines, political intrigue, kingdom-building, powerful enemies, and a slow-burn journey from an ordinary boy to the last hope of a forgotten civilization.

data.title: Leochrupidis: Minus One
data.description:
There were barriers—barriers that extended upward endlessly. What lay beyond these barriers remained unbeknown to humanity. Yet, from beyond them emerged unimaginable entities known as Partians. They were eerie, aberrant creatures—often anthropomorphic, but imbued with unnatural strength. An amalgam of both human and animal genes, they far transcended the frontiers of human capability. 
Seemingly, they were deemed to be humanity's gravest enemy. Within the barriers, that was.

That day—after the invasion—everything changed. Sent away from danger, Kisatsu woke up in an unfamiliar room three days after the invasion had taken everything from him. A nation away from home, facing all odds, he swore to retrieve his older brother—everything he had left.
